CustomField.description: Customer tier label derived from Customer Lifetime Spend. System-maintained formula; do not edit manually.
CustomField.formula: IF(Customer_Lifetime_Spend__c <= 0, "Not a Valid Customer", IF(Customer_Lifetime_Spend__c < 10000, "New Customer", IF(Customer_Lifetime_Spend__c < 50000, "Regular Customer", IF(Customer_Lifetime_Spend__c < 100000, "Valued Customer", IF(Customer_Lifetime_Spend__c < 250000, "High Value Customer", IF(Customer_Lifetime_Spend__c < 500000, "Premium Customer", IF(Customer_Lifetime_Spend__c < 1000000, "VIP Customer", IF(Customer_Lifetime_Spend__c < 2500000, "Elite Customer", "Platinum Customer"))))))))
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Automatically calculated from Customer Lifetime Spend.
CustomField.label: Customer Tags
